mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth declines by >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3mo avg PAYEMS > 200k but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a high-inflation, restrictive monetary policy environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 decline and UNRATE +0.5pp 3mo change but SPX 20-day returns are positive >60% of the time.
